name: ros2-bridge
description: Introspect and drive a ROS 2 robot from Claude.
long_description: A ROS 2 <-> MCP bridge. Exposes tools to list topics/nodes, read the robot pose and laser scan, drive via /cmd_vel, send Nav2 goals, and run any ros2 CLI command. Requires a ROS 2 (Jazzy) installation on the machine — its setup.bash is sourced before the server starts. Python deps (the mcp SDK) are bundled in server/lib; rclpy and message packages come from your ROS install.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List all active ROS 2 topics and their message types.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Send a Nav2 goal to (x, y, yaw).

tools.name: get_camera_image
tools.description: Capture the robot camera to a JPEG (waffle model).

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Record topics to a rosbag dataset.

tools.name: run_ros2
tools.description: Run any ros2 CLI command and return its output.

ros_setup.title: ROS 2 setup.bash
ros_setup.description: Absolute path to your ROS 2 setup.bash, sourced before the server starts.
